evidence: Counts re-derived from the frozen judge.toml files: 1 render gate + 2 constraints gates, 42 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual likert. Every one of the 3 gate, 42 functional and 6 polish criterion ids has a true result in the scripted golden results (editor.json 21, runtime.json 15 incl. the render gate, persist-before/after 8 ids covering 7 functional + cw_shared_saved_record, polish.json 7 incl. cw_custom_document_surface), pageErrors empty; all 22 indexed artifact hashes match, and task/solution is byte-identical to projects/colderwater-playground-devtools/solution, which run_golden.sh mounts. Independent source walk agrees with each criterion: thrown-error and rejection lines come from sourceURL-tagged stacks and Promise wrapping (runtime.ts:113-136, 213-229, 357); HTML lines are offset to the whole file (runtime.ts:322-330, 357); loop/function guards plus a 5.1 s parent watchdog give the time-limit reason (runtime.ts:141, 374); Stop and a newer Run drop the old frame and token (runtime.ts:378-392); last-good keeps input values and canvas pixels (runtime.ts:8-24, 176-203); trusted interaction after settle starts a new budget (runtime.ts:278-282); eval/Function/WebAssembly/Worker are refused by CSP with a visible reason and dynamic import statically (runtime.ts:7, 50-52, 220-228); connect-src 'none' and a sandboxed cross-host frame give isolation (runtime.ts:7, 387-391); revision-checked save, idempotent restore by operationId and SQLite at DB_PATH (server.js:8, 52-59, 95-119); 2 s library poll that only replaces the list, newer-revision notice, conflict notice, 'Retry same restore' control, dirty marker and focus return (app.tsx:62-76, 82-95, 136-144, 151-162); editor has no auto-close or auto-indent so judge-typed fixtures stay exact, with Ctrl+Z/Y/Shift+Z, Ctrl+A, Ctrl+Home/End, clipboard events, modifier-click carets, double/triple click (custom-editor.js:248-403); five distinct JS token treatments and HTML tag/attribute colours (style.css:25-31). No criterion quotes a seeded figure, ordering or arithmetic the golden could miss (seed scope has no user records). Visual: golden-1440.png shows aligned line numbers, visible selection and caret, a two-row toolbar and a wrapped library with no clipping; the earlier candidate scored 5/4/5 on the three likert criteria. Not measured on these bytes: any configured-judge run (functional, polish and visual judge verdicts, including the new cw_basic_run_output and the reworded render gate); the hosted 0.9833 Oracle result belongs to an earlier candidate and is not carried over. Latent hazard (P3, no observed impact): runtime.ts:336-342 converts inline on* attributes only when they are present in an .html source; an inline handler created at run time (innerHTML or setAttribute from a .js draft) is blocked by the nonce-only script-src (runtime.ts:361) and the violation listener ignores it (runtime.ts:224-228), so the control does nothing and nothing is reported. cw_last_good_recovery (weight 2.0 of 58.5 functional) leaves the fixture's filename and handler style to the judge; the scripted fixture and the earlier hosted judge used working forms, so this is a judge-fixture risk of about 0.02 reward, not a criterion the reference cannot pass. Also noted: typing in the render gate makes the draft dirty, so the reload raises a beforeunload dialog (app.tsx:125); app_context.md tells the judge accepting it is normal and lib.cjs auto-accepts, but no configured judge has run that gate on these bytes.
counterexample: Judge authors cw_last_good_recovery as a .js draft: document.body.innerHTML = '<input id=i><canvas id=c width=60 height=40></canvas><button onclick="c.getContext(\'2d\').fillRect(0,0,60,40)">Draw</button>'. The golden runs it as 'Complete', but clicking Draw does nothing and no message appears, so the canvas never changes and the judge may fail the criterion although the reference implements last-good recovery. Not executed in this read-only review; derived from runtime.ts:7, 224-228, 336-342, 361.
suggested_fix: In the golden's sandbox bootstrap, either attach handlers for on* attributes added after load (MutationObserver plus a nonce-carrying script) or report script-src-attr violations as a visible console message; then run the configured judge once on the final bytes to measure functional, polish and visual.
